test_title: SSC Selection Post Graduation Level Official Paper (Held on: 1 Aug 2022 Shift 4)
subject: general
question: In 1930, __ __ led a satyagraha for the rights of untouchables' entry to the Kalaram temple at Nasik.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Dr B.R. Ambedkar.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **B. R. Ambedkar** led a protest out of doors of the temple on 2 March 1930, in order to permit Dalits into the temple.
 
• The development was to reserve an option to enter the sanctuary.
 
• Kalaram Mandir is arranged inside the Panchvati area of **Nashik City.**
 
• The Sanctuary Passage Development of **1927 **was begun by Bhimrao Ambedkar.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Sardar k M Panicker** is known as him 'Madan Mohan Malaviya' of Kerala.
 
• **Mohandas Karamchand Gandhi** becomes an Indian legal professional, anti-colonial nationalist, and political ethicist.
 
• **Mylai Chinna Thambi Pillai Rajah **was an Indian politician, educationist, and social and political activist from the Indian state of Tamil Nadu.
